index_record.dataset_generation_caption:
The figure presents a vertical flowchart illustrating a four-step data processing pipeline, labeled sequentially from A1 to A4, designed for spectral analysis in an astrophysical context. The global layout is linear and top-to-bottom, with each step represented by a horizontally-aligned rectangular box connected by downward-pointing arrows, indicating a sequential workflow. All boxes have black borders and white backgrounds, with black text for the main step titles and gray text for associated section references below each title.

The first module, A1, is titled 'Data Preprocessing' and includes parenthetical details: '(Stellar photosphere Subtraction, Define Average Emissivity)'. Below this, in gray font, is the reference '§ 3.1. 3.2', indicating the relevant sections in the paper. This box is positioned at the top of the chart.

The second module, A2, is labeled 'Model Disk Continuum', with the gray reference '§ 3.3' beneath it. It follows directly below A1 and is connected by a solid, light-blue arrow pointing downward.

The third module, A3, reads 'Bin Data to Improve SNR', with the gray reference '§ 3.4' underneath. It is located below A2 and linked by another identical light-blue downward arrow.

The final module, A4, is titled 'Normalize Spectra', with the gray reference '§ 3.5' below it. It sits at the bottom of the flowchart and is connected to A3 by the same style of light-blue arrow.

All connecting arrows are uniform in color (light blue), thickness, and direction (downward), emphasizing the unidirectional, step-by-step progression of the data processing procedure. There are no branching paths or feedback loops; the structure is strictly linear. The visual design is minimalistic, focusing on clarity and logical sequence. The caption accompanying the figure states: 'A Flowchart of Data Processing Steps (P1): Each rectangular box represents a data processing step (in black fonts) and its corresponding subsections (in gray fonts) in the next section.' This confirms that the gray text denotes the paper’s section numbers where each step is described in detail.
